Short-cropped, messy ash-brown hair with jagged bangs. Small, wide-set hazel eyes with a cautious expression. Appears in early twenties with a youthful, soft face. Slender build with a slight frame. Wears a rustic linen tunic in olive green and tan leather trousers. A worn leather utility belt holds a small pouch and a utility knife.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
